title: 第4744章 黄裳的地盘第4743章 找到虎前辈
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
“让我来。”
黄裳看到那头老虎已经受伤，马上向叶云飞传音说道。
下一刻，叶云飞就看到前方的空间中开始有大量的鬼雾聚集。
这些鬼雾是由精纯到极点的鬼气能量凝聚而成，其中还有一些厉鬼冤魂。
接着滔天鬼气汹涌澎湃，向着那些围攻老虎的生灵淹没过去。
这一片空间之中的鬼气能量威力十分可怕，具有着强大的镇压作用，很快就让那些围攻老虎的生灵感到了巨大的压力。
啊……
有一些实力比较弱小的生灵开始被鬼气能量入侵，产生了种种幻象。
鬼气能量和幻道能量都能够让生灵产生一些恐怖的幻象。
“大家小心一些，这里的鬼气能量似乎开始发生了异动，有可能是那些鬼魂在搞鬼。”
一个嘴巴又尖又长的老者开口叫道。
这个老者的种族特征十分明显，一看就让人知道他是九头鸟一族的。
“什么狗屁鬼气能量？
我一刀就能砍灭！”
一个头顶上方悬浮着一把长刀的男子冷笑着说道。
然后他伸手握住刀柄，向前一砍。
轰隆隆……
千万道璀璨的刀芒绽放，瞬间就将一团向他移动过来的鬼雾砍灭。
但是下一刻，有更多的鬼雾滚滚翻滚着向他冲撞过来，而且那些鬼雾之中还有很多厉鬼冤魂在发出尖锐的鬼叫声，伸出尖尖的鬼爪，从四面八方呼啸着向他抓过来。
“黄老，你果然可以轻松控制这些鬼气能量。

那些鬼魂居然也在这么短的时间内就被你控制住了。”
叶云飞看到围攻老虎的那些生灵正在被大量的鬼气能量以及鬼魂攻击，又惊又喜。
“这些鬼气能量和鬼魂对我都十分畏惧，我只需要释放出我的气息，对它们进行驱赶，就能够将它们赶到特定的位置，甚至可以强迫它们攻击其他的生灵。”
黄裳笑着说道。
“在这种环境之中就等于到了我的地盘。”
黄裳又说道。
接下来有越来越多强大的鬼气能量，源源不断地向着那些正在围攻老虎的生灵淹没过去。
这些生灵本来正在围攻那头老虎，但是现在突然遭受到这么多的鬼气能量以及鬼魂的围攻，顿时就打乱了他们的节奏。
而那头老虎也是顿感压力大减，变得轻松起来，然后他就收到了猴子、山羊等几头动物的传音，知道叶云飞已经来到，不由得精神大振。
“混老，现在轮到我们出手了。”
叶云飞看到有越来越多的鬼气能量以及鬼魂正在围攻那些生灵，于是对混老说道。
content_en:
"Let me do it."
When Huang Shang saw that the tiger was injured, he immediately sent a message to Ye Yunfei.
The next moment, Ye Yunfei saw a large amount of ghost mist beginning to gather in the space ahead.
These ghost mist are condensed from extremely pure ghost energy, and there are also some ghosts and ghosts in them.
Then the monstrous ghost energy surged and flooded towards the creatures that besieged the tiger.
The ghost energy in this space is very powerful and has a strong suppressive effect. It soon puts great pressure on the creatures that besiege the tiger.
Ah...
Some relatively weak creatures began to be invaded by ghost energy, causing various illusions.
Both ghost energy and illusion energy can cause some terrifying illusions to creatures.
"Everyone, please be careful. The ghost energy here seems to be changing. It may be those ghosts who are causing trouble."
An old man with a sharp and long mouth shouted.
This old man's racial characteristics are very obvious, and one can tell at a glance that he belongs to the Nine-Headed Bird Clan.
“What bullshit ghost energy?
I can kill it with one strike! "
A man with a long knife suspended above his head said with a sneer.
Then he reached out, grasped the handle of the knife, and slashed forward.
Rumble…
Thousands of bright sword lights bloomed, instantly cutting down a group of ghost mist moving towards him.
But the next moment, there were more ghost mist rolling towards him, and there were many evil ghosts in the ghost mist making sharp screams, extending their pointed ghost claws, whistling and grabbing at him from all directions.
"Huang Lao, you can indeed control these ghost energy easily.
Those ghosts were actually controlled by you in such a short period of time. "
Ye Yunfei was surprised and happy to see that the creatures besieging the tiger were being attacked by a large amount of ghost energy and ghosts.
"These ghost energy and ghosts are very afraid of me. I only need to release my breath and drive them away. I can drive them to a specific location and even force them to attack other creatures."
Huang Shang said with a smile.
"Being in this environment is equivalent to being on my territory."
Huang Shang said again.
Then there was more and more powerful ghost energy, flooding towards the creatures that were besieging the tiger.
These creatures were originally besieging the tiger, but now they were suddenly attacked by so much ghost energy and ghosts, which immediately disrupted their rhythm.
The tiger also suddenly felt that the pressure was greatly reduced and became relaxed. Then he received transmissions from monkeys, goats and other animals. He knew that Ye Yunfei had arrived, and he couldn't help but feel refreshed.
"Hun Lao, now it's our turn to take action."
Ye Yunfei saw more and more ghost energy and ghosts besieging those creatures, so he said to Mr. Hun.
